{{Top|leg}}
An '''embryo''' was a stage of [[Human/Legends|Human]] development and one of its earliest stages. An [[embryologist]] studied embryos and their development. An embryo developed naturally as part of Human [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]], but could also be stimulated to grow artificially via [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]]. Embryos of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were grown and monitored on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in strictly controlled environments. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] first inspected the Kamino cloning facilities, he felt waves of life-energy emanating from the countless embryos surrounding him.

Embryonic development was not limited to Humans. [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] referred to its developing [[Sekotan Personal Starship|seed-ships]] as "embryos." [[Nen Yim]] vivisected the embryo of a [[kul]].
